capability.name: extract-outline
capability.description: Extract document outline/table of contents with hierarchical structure

required.name: file_path
required.description: Path to the document file to process

optional.name: output
optional.description: Write output to specified file instead of stdout

optional.name: max_depth
optional.description: Maximum depth of outline hierarchy to extract

optional.name: include_page_numbers
optional.description: Include page numbers in outline entries where available

response.description: Hierarchical outline structure with titles, levels, and page references

FILE_NOT_FOUND.description: The specified file does not exist

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.description: The file format is not supported by this plugin

NO_OUTLINE_AVAILABLE.message: Document contains no outline or table of contents
NO_OUTLINE_AVAILABLE.description: The document does not have an extractable outline structure

OUTLINE_PARSING_FAILED.description: Outline extraction process failed due to parsing error
